paragraphs: What Abha says about her Art,

Painting is a way of life for me. It’s a combination of old and new methods. It’s constantly evolving. Although I paint diverse subjects, birds are special for me. They rouse my imagination and creativity. It gives me the joy to paint a bird that I spot in the wild. Having studied great artists like Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raja Ravi Verma, Kishangarh art, etc during my Masters in Fine Arts, I enjoy the conservative style of art for instance good old impressionist art or abstract art. At the same time, I enjoy experimenting with new concepts like pour in acrylic.

paragraphs: Sattal is one of the places that is close to big cities and shows a different form of nature – the world of birds. The forest of Sattal is filled with oak trees , situated at the height of 1400 Metres due to which many birds come to breed from down South India throughout the summer, among these a lot of ‘Fly Catcher’ species, one of which is – Paradise Fly Catcher , Many birds come here in winter from cold areas such as finches, raptors and warblers.
This is the most famous area of Sattal among birders, many birds come here to bathe in the water, photographers from all over the world capture pictures of many birds here.

This road trail exhibits a lot of bird activity in the morning, as well as a view of ‘Garuda Tal’ and ‘Sattal’ and ‘Hanuman Tal’, this trail is very good for resident birds, beautiful birds like Scarlet Minivet are seen here almost dail
Rare species like Scaly Thrush in the winters make this place their home, then in the summer species of owls like – Brown Wood Owl.
Birds are also fed at some places in Sattal and there is also a birdbath, one such bird hide is also inside the WILD KUMAON campus.

chanfi is an amazing birding area for small Birds, warblers, and water-dependent Birds. Different topography in comparison to the Sattal region this area is home to different species which you don’t find in Sattal. Tawny Fish Owl, Little Forktail and Brown Dipper are some highlights from the area. a must-visit area if you are coming to Sattal.

In a year, about 250 species are found in Sattal – Some of the rarest summer species are Long-tailed Broadbill, Brown Wood Owl, Gray Croned Parinees, Mountain Scopes Owl, Mountain Hawk Eagle. Some beautiful winter species are – Small Niltava, Rufous Bellied NIltava, Rufous-gorgeted Flycatcher, Golden Bush Robin, Common Green Magpie, Pink Browd Rosfinch. Some exotic birds also live in the target of bird watchers in winter…. one of which is the Siberian rubythroat – this bird reaches Sattal from the upper cold regions of Europe and China. It looks very beautiful blooming in the middle and there is a desire in the mind to come out for a moment and see it. There are other areas along with Satatal which are famous for birds and which are visited with the Satatal Bird Watching Tour – Pangot, Chanfi, Ramgarh, Shyamkhet – These are the areas where there is very good boarding and many such species are found which are not found in Sattal. Chanfi is famous for – Brown Dipper, the only species which breeds in winters here.
The right time to visit Sattal and other vicinity area is : Summer – April to June In winter – November to March

Places to stay at Sattal – Wild Kumaon – located in Sattal. This eco-resort is dedicated exclusively to bird watchers, situated at a great location providing you quick access to birding spots, there is also a bird head, close to all the birding areas of Sattal.

headings.text: WILD KUMAON proudly supports 'Sattal Conservation Club'

paragraphs: Sattal Conservation Club is a not for profit organisation, run by volunteers. It work towards conserving the forest and wildlife resources in the ecologically sensitive region of Sattal.

headings.text: The future of Sattal’s lakes and forest are at a huge risk!

paragraphs: Home to over 525 varieties of butterflies and over 500 species of birds including The Red-Headed Vulture (Critically Endangered), Cinereous Vulture (Near Threatened), Grey Crowned Prinia (Vulnerable), Pallas’s Fish Eagle (Endangered), as well as other flora and fauna like the King Cobra (Vulnerable), Himalayan Serow (Vulnerable), Foxtail Orchid (Endangered), the world’s largest moth – Atacus Atlas, Sattal is also a refuge to high-quality oak-dominated hardwood forests (which are currently endangered in Kumaon region, due to pine invasion, fire and fragmentation), which need to be protected URGENTLY!
At an altitude of 4000 feet, this exotic amalgamation of nature is at risk of being destroyed under the garb of ‘beautification’.

At an estimated cost of INR 6-7 Cr. there is a plan to ‘DEVELOP’ the area around the Sattal lakes and forest to make way for shops, parking, children’s park, viewpoint, plantation, etc. All this under the veil of ‘LAKESIDE DEVELOPMENT’ by government authorities.
listItems: This proposal has the potential to wreak havoc in the area and needs to be stopped NOW!
It is not about one project. It is about saving the home of thousands of species of flora and fauna.
We need the people’s power to request the authorities to declare Sattal a CONSERVATION RESERVE AND STOP ACTIVITY THAT WILL DESTROY THE ECOLOGY OF THE AREA.
Getting Sattal the status of a CONSERVATION RESERVE will help PRESERVE THE ECOLOGY of the area.
It is people like you who can influence change.

paragraphs: It is a privilege to swim in Sattal, as the lakes here are pure freshwater lakes and surrounded by natural forests, the quality of the water is very good. Swimming in Sattal is one of the most beautiful activities to experience here, the expert team of Wild Kumaon is present in the lake with you and also provides you with the necessary equipment if required. Come experience this most beautiful lake of Nainital and its water.

It is great to be completely present and connect with nature, and the purpose of this walk is that only. Neer believes that things get better by connecting to the nature and nature can be enjoyed by being in the present. On the walk you find yourself among the birds, wildlife and the fresh water lakes. Neer gives you various types of information, interesting facts with novelty this walk talks about insects, plants, birds and the sky and discovers how we are connected with all these and what is their importance . The experience usually goes for 2.5 hours. The experience includes packed breakfast.

Sattal keeps on echoing with the voices of birds. Many species come here in summer and winter, this experience connects you with these species. In this three-four-hour morning experience, you walk on the trail of Sattal along with your expert Bird Guide.
You will receive the photographs of the Birds you saw and a checklist of the total species.
The experience includes breakfast at Wild Kumaon premises for each participant.
Embark upon a journey in sound!
Specially selected instruments such as gongs, singing bowls, and others, tuned to destress your being, are deployed to take on a sonic journey.
You will at the end of the session leave feeling calm and re-energized.
The entire experience includes a group sound immersion, hydration with a light snack and lasts for approximately two hours including conversation pre and post immersion.
Your contribution in the form of a donation is highly appreciated as the proceeds are used to further the charitable work that the Shoonya One Foundation Trust undertakes.
Note: The group size is limited to four people or less.
Link to reserve the experience :

paragraphs: Ans. Garud Tal is located approximately 2.5 km from the WILD KUMAON eco-resort, while Sattal is located approximately 3.5 km from the resort. Trekking: Sattal is surrounded by lush green forests and hills, making it an excellent destination for trekking. Visitors can take a trek through the forests and hills and explore the natural beauty of the area.

Overall, WILD KUMAON eco resort provides convenient and reliable transportation services to ensure that its guests can travel safely and comfortably to and from the resort and nearby tourist destinations.

paragraphs: Please write your comments

We had this wonderful tour with Ankit Das Loiwal' in late March to Chopta, a team of 'Wild Kumaon'. 'Ankit' the tour leader made us experience wonderful sightings, well behaviour, comfortable and deep birding. we will always go with 'Ankit Das' from now on, really appreciate his field work and the gentle approach towards birds. We made really good photographs of higher altitude rare birds. Thankyou 'Wild Kumaon' and 'Ankit Das Loiwal' for this amazing tour. Looking forward for my next visit to Sattal and Uttarakhand.

Wild Kumaon is where you want to stay in Sattal. Below are various points which I think works in favour of them... 1. New property 2. Humble people 3. Good jungle environment 4. Good food 5. Learned naturalist 6. Good bird sighting within the premises I really enjoyed my stay there...before staying here I stayed at some other property in Sattal. I am glad I shifted here. Do visit there and enjoy the hospitality of Wild Kumaon!!!​

We have recently been to Wild Kumaon, Sattal. It was an awesome experience... Location, ambiance, space, cleanliness are more than what I had expected. Simply great site on best location. Highly recommended to friends interested in birding. Special mention of Mr. Gopal alongwith Madan bhai for taking good care with delicious kumaoni food. A very soft spoken and knowledgeable naturalist Ankit das. Looking forward to visit again.

Awesome experience... We have recently been to Wild Kumaon, Sattal. The place is fantastic, a nature lover's paradise. One can hear the chirping of the birds from morning till evening. We had the most hospitable hosts, very friendly, caring, and served very delicious food (special thanks for Kumaonis food). One can have the feeling of a family in this beautiful place. Highly recommended this stay. Thanks to Neer and the team for being an awesome host at Wild Kumaon

My husband and I spent a delightful day birding with Neer (Wild Kumaon Sattal). He took immense pains to ensure we saw the maximum number of birds in various places around Sattal. It was thrilling seeing the Himalayan Barbet, Blue throated barbet, different varieties of laughing thrush, slaty headed parakeet, Spotted forktail, Little forktail, white capped Redstart etc etc etc. Hugely thrilling. Thank you Neer. The property at Wild Kumaon Sattal is also very comfortable and a home away from home with tasty and healthy meals. I definitely recommend this place for nature lovers

Amazing amazing place to stay at when in Sattal. I felt like home, happy and very safe. The hospitality, the tasty food, the room service, the staff, and the team of naturalists everything here is just superb. The best part, specially for birders is you just have to open the windows to see/click birds. Lots of birds I got to see from the corridor 🙂 Must check this place out when planning for Sattal. Thanks to Mikma Tamang for introducing this place to me. And thanks to Neer for being an awesome host at Wild Kumaon. Kudos team Wild Kumaon

Wild Kumaon Sattal is one of the best property that I have ever seen. Each an every aspect it is so special that I will proudly recommend every one to stay there. Location, interior, food, peoples all are mind blowing. Kash I can give more stars but unfortunately 5 is available so I give 5 only. Heart full thanks to Wild Kumaon Sattal and Team.

We have recently been to Wild Kumaon, Sattal. The place is absolutely fantastic, a nature lover's paradise. It is built aside a scenic landscape, surrounded by wild forest. One can hear the chirping of the birds till evening. We had the most hospitable hosts, very friendly, caring and served very delicious, home made food. One can have the feeling of a family in this beautiful place. Highly recommended this stay.

This is the best place for anyone in Sattal. The location is outstanding, their food, hospitality , rooms all are just perfect. I stayed there 3days with my team for Birding. they have their own hide & you can book other hides too through them. they will arrange everything perfectly. the most important thing is that their field work is exceptionally great. if you visit this place for Birding Do search for Neer ji, a very disciplined & punctual guy I must say. another great aspect is they are associated with the great Dinesh Negi Ji , the best bird guide in Chopta Valley. so if you plan to visit Chopta too then you are in good hands. I stayed 5days in Chopta with Dinesh Ji & 3days in Sattal & took outstanding images of at least 90 species of birds. I promise I will visit every year.

Simply an amazing place to stay in Sattal! Absolutely clean and hygienic. The food cooked by Madan bhaiyya is absolutely delicious! They cooked a special local meal for us after we just asked what are the local food options in Sattal. The hospitality is so good that you are at ease and comfortable instantly. The birding scene right from the balcony is insane. They do have a hide within the premises as well. Additionally you can get a birding guide (personal recommendation would be Mikma Tamang) to visit far off places like Pangoot, Manila, Chanfi, Chopta. All in all, if you are visiting Sattal, definitely checkout Wild Kumaon. Neer bhaiya who owns the place is a great host!

paragraphs: Junglehike’s birding trip to Sattal – Wild Kumaon, Pangot and Nainital.
Date: 16 th -19 th March 2022

Sattal, Pangot and Nainital showcased the rustic beauty of the lower Himalayas. Despite the temperature being on the warmer side the birds made their presence felt. The natural studios at regular intervals in Sattal, the pine forests of Pangot and dry rocky areas of Nainital had us celebrating a different ‘Holi’ of the feathered kind. Some birds were very vocal, some were skulking and some were openly displaying their breeding moves and grooves!
